description: Sites mobiles 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G - Ville d'Anglet is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune d'Anglet. This dataset identifies and locates the latest version of the mobile antennas of the four operators and the availability of different technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G) in the territory of the municipality of Anglet. Coverage: Commune d'Anglet. The portal shows the English title as "Mobile Sites 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G – City of Anglet" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune d'Anglet. Its keywords include urbanisme-equipement, amenagement, telephone, voix, territoire, mobile. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2022-11-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
